question: What are Qnami's current main strengths? Give short bullet points
answer:
Here are Qnami’s current main strengths, summarized in concise bullet points:

• World-leading quantum sensing expertise  
  Qnami is recognized as a pioneer and leader in quantum sensing, particularly in developing and commercializing quantum technologies for sensing and imaging applications ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai)).

• Cutting-edge instrumentation: ProteusQ  
  Their flagship product, the ProteusQ scanning NV magnetometer, offers unmatched spatial resolution and magnetic sensitivity under ambient conditions, enabling quantitative, non-perturbative nanoscale imaging ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai)).

• Vertically integrated diamond sensor production  
  Through their Quantum Foundry, Qnami engineers and manufactures synthetic diamond NV sensors at scale, offering both standardized and custom solutions for academic and industrial clients ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/portfolio/quantum-foundry/?utm_source=openai)).

• Strong academic and industrial collaborations  
  Qnami collaborates with leading universities and institutions (e.g., CNRS-Thales, UC Berkeley, MPI Dresden) and supports semiconductor innovation via partnerships like VerticalCompute ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai)).

• Global distribution and market expansion  
  They have established strategic distribution partnerships with Quantum Design in Japan and Korea, and with HORIBA for global reach, enabling broader access to their quantum sensing platforms ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/qnami-expands-to-east-asia/?utm_source=openai)).

• Broad application versatility  
  Qnami’s technology is applied across diverse fields—materials science, spintronics, 2D materials, magnetic memories, superconductors, skyrmions, and more—demonstrating its adaptability and research impact ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/applications/?utm_source=openai)).
